title: Non-trivial characters have mean zero
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S \subseteq [n]$ be a nonempty set of coordinates. Then the Walsh--Fourier character $\chi_S(x) = \prod_{i \in S}(-1)^{x_i}$ has vanishing uniform expectation over the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$:
\[
  \E[\chi_S] = \frac{1}{2^n}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} \chi_S(x) = 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S is a nonempty subset of the coordinates
